feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: The midterms were the largest win for either party in 50 years
entry.summary: Some 56% of people cast votes for Democrats in House races, compared to 42% who voted Republican. That 14-point spread is the widest win for either party in 50 years, since after Watergate.

entry.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
entry.summary: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.

entry.title: World Toilet Day is a funny idea with a serious goal: A world awash in toilets
entry.summary: Yahoo for the loo! November 19 marks the 25th anniversary of World Toilet Day. The theme this year: "Sanitation and Gender Equality: Safe Toilets, Equal Futures."

entry.title: Incoming House majority leader Katherine Clark stresses Democratic unity
entry.summary: As Democrats prepare to take control of the House, incoming majority leader Katherine Clark discusses the party's ambitious agenda and divisions within its ranks.

entry.title: Muslims will outnumber Christians worldwide by 2035, report says
entry.summary: By 2070, the Democratic Republic of the Congo will surpass the United States as the country with the largest total number of Christians.

entry.title: Investors scramble for a piece of AI giant Anthropic in blockbuster IPO
entry.summary: Shares in the maker of the popular Claude artificial intelligence model will start trading on the Nasdaq Thursday.

entry.title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet as global alliances hang in the balance
entry.summary: President Trump, China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin have gathered in Shenzhen, China, for a historic trilateral meeting, with Ukraine, Iran and nuclear disarmament on the agenda.

entry.title: 'Huna' writer wins National Book Award for non-fiction, after not being allowed into the U.S.
entry.summary: Abdelrahman ElGendy published a recent essay about being denied a visa to enter the U.S. for the ceremony. His book is a memoir about his time as a political prisoner in Egypt.

entry.title: Win a trip to go behind the news with NPR
entry.summary: Enter for a chance to go behind the scenes at HQ, meet our journalists face-to-face and experience public media like never before.

entry.title: Anthropic IPO raises record $81.3 billion on strong AI demand
entry.summary: The five-year-old artificial intelligence powerhouse priced its initial public offering at $83 a share, shrugging off growing concern about a possible AI bubble and volatility in tech stocks.
